pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: r8152: disable RX aggregation on Dell TB16 dock r8153 on Dell TB15/16 dock corrupts rx packets. This change is suggested by Realtek. They guess that the XHCI controller doesn't have enough buffer, and their guesswork is correct, once the RX aggregation gets disabled, the issue is gone. ASMedia is currently working on a real sulotion for this issue. Dell and ODM confirm the bcdDevice and iSerialNumber is unique for TB16. Note that TB15 has different bcdDevice and iSerialNumber, which are not unique values. If you still have TB15, please contact Dell to replace it with TB16. UPSTREAM: r8152: fix wrong checksum status for received IPv4 packets The device could only check the checksum of TCP and UDP packets. Therefore, for the IPv4 packets excluding TCP and UDP, the check of checksum is necessary, even though the IP checksum is correct. UPSTREAM: net: usb: r8152: use irqsave() in USB's complete callback The USB completion callback does not disable interrupts while acquiring the lock. We want to remove the local_irq_disable() invocation from __usb_hcd_giveback_urb() and therefore it is required for the callback handler to disable the interrupts while acquiring the lock. The callback may be invoked either in IRQ or BH context depending on the USB host controller. Use the _irqsave() variant of the locking primitives. Cc: "David S. Regenerate the mock owner public key and metric_{on,off} policies At some point, the acceptable format for the owner key changed, in terms of header sizes. This can be seen in commit d29ae33459d4 ("Updated policy_testserver to support verification key signatures"), in the chrome repo. Unfortunately, the code in this directory was not updated. As a result, if a user had logged into a test machine at any point before running platform_KernelErrorPaths (i.e. the machine has an owner), the test machine gets powerwashed and the test fails. The original code for generating the public key and the policy blobs is found attached to this document: https://sites.google.com/a/google.com/chromeos/archive/testing-tools-for-device-policies Along with it are the instructions to generate the keys. We follow these instructions and commit the updated code. TEST=platform_KernelErrorPaths.BUG passes after this. Tried running platform_KernelErrorPaths.ALL, but it has other issues.
